videos.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
videos.description: Guy Fieri's kicking it Cajun, Asian and more, starting at a Los Gatos, Calif., eatery with their gangster gumbo; a sushi spot in Riviera Beach, Fla., is plating the-bomb basil shrimp; a joint in Sacramento, Calif., is firing up big-deal brisket ramen.

videos.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
videos.description: Guy Fieri's sampling Southern, sweet and Spammy sensations! A triple-G champ is serving craveable cake in Calgary, Alberta; a husband and wife team in Reno, Nev., is rocking killer collards; an Asheville, N.C., joint is cooking up a sweet soy Spam bowl.

videos.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
videos.description: Guy Fieri visits Sacramento, Calif., for pork tacos and a Palm Beach Gardens, Fla., restaurant for brisket sandwiches; in San Jose, Calif., a Cambodian restaurant serves pork belly noodles.

videos.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
videos.description: Guy Fieri gets into seafood, sandwiches and more; a joint in Baton Rouge, La., makes a Cuban sandwich, a Gainesville, Fla., bakery serves an artichoke croissant and a spot in Tallahassee, Fla., features pineapples.

videos.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
videos.description: Guy Fieri digs into delicious dumplings and traditional beef noodle soup in Dallas; a funky spot in Naples, FL, embraces fare like gator sausage and frog legs; a Chicago joint serves up lights-out mojo pork with plantains.

videos.title: Carnival Eats
videos.description: The South Florida Fair in West Palm Beach has wacky takes on fairground classics: The Waffle Burger, Donut Philly Cheesesteak and 'Zanado Fries'; Noah attends the National Western Stock Show and Rodeo in Denver, where he's introduced to The F Bomb.

videos.title: Carnival Eats
videos.description: Noah attends the Fort Worth Stock Show and Rodeo in Texas to sample the Cowboy Burrito and the Texan Juicy Lucy; the Bacon Burger Bomb at the Florida State Fair in Tampa; funnel cake pizza; Chocoberry Orie.

videos.title: Inogen Portable Oxygen - No More Tanks!
videos.description: Regain independence and enjoy greater mobility with the compact design and long-lasting battery of portable oxygen.

videos.title: Girl Meets Farm
videos.description: Molly Yeh is whipping up fun takes on Thanksgiving classics for her Friendsgiving gathering on the farm; her main dish is sweet and savory pomegranate-glazed turkey legs.

videos.title: Girl Meets Farm
videos.description: Thanksgiving on the farm; creamy twice-baked potatoes; brussels sprout casserole; sweet and sticky orange marmalade glazed ham; pumpkin pie with whipped cream and cinnamon.

videos.title: Girl Meets Farm
videos.description: Molly Yeh is celebrating Thanksgiving with tons of food and a tiny parade on the farm; crispy fried turkey breasts with cranberry mayo, everything bagel stuffing, tahini cinnamon sweet potatoes with toasted meringue and pistachio pudding pie.

videos.title: Girl Meets Farm
videos.description: Molly Yeh is making mash-up dishes for a Chinese-inspired Thanksgiving.

videos.title: The Pioneer Woman
videos.description: Ree's roasted turkey; cornbread dressing with sausage and apples; sweet roasted rosemary acorn squash wedges; cranberry sauce; green beans and tomatoes.

videos.title: The Pioneer Woman
videos.description: Ree Drummond makes her Thanksgiving recipes; the feast includes her foolproof simple roasted turkey with a herby butter, easy cornbread and sausage stuffing and classic giblet gravy; the trick to a shortcut cranberry sauce.

videos.title: The Pioneer Woman
videos.description: Ree Drummond answers questions about Thanksgiving; breakfast casserole; pumpkin tiramisu; Nan's cranberry sauce; celery logs with pimento cheese; apple pie martinis; turkey tips and festive cooking on the ranch.

videos.title: The Pioneer Woman
videos.description: Ree Drummond gives Thanksgiving leftovers a twist for her "day after Thanksgiving" breakfast sandwiches, turkey spaghetti, loaded potato croquettes and pecan pie milkshakes.

videos.title: The Kitchen
videos.description: The Kitchen hosts explore Turkey Day basics with essential recipes and tips for every home cook; there's a butterflied roast turkey with easy orange spice rub, creamy potato purée, creamy green bean salad and classic chess pie for dessert.

videos.title: The Kitchen
videos.description: The Kitchen goes back in time to give turkey day staples an update; Jeff Mauro and Geoffrey Zakarian team up for a classic Thanksgiving turkey and vintage cranberry sauce mold; Sunny Anderson gives Grandma Williams' squash pie a citrus makeover.

videos.title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy
videos.description: Danielle Sepsy transforms everyday fruits and vegetables into comforting, bakery-style treats; first, she creates her Best Carrot Cake, layering moist cake with tangy cream cheese frosting; then, ripe bananas become soft, sweet Sugar Cookie Banana Bread.

videos.title: Best Bake Ever With Danielle Sepsy
videos.description: Danielle Sepsy teams up with her mom to make Pepperoni Stromboli with a flavorful filling and golden crust; Danielle welcomes her grandma to the kitchen to make a Mile High Classic Top-Heavy Deli Crumb Cake with a thick layer of buttery crumbs.

videos.title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
videos.description: James and Oliver Phelps challenge the teams to create cakes inspired by the first Harry Potter movie and their favorite spells; the showpieces are delivered to the Quidditch pitch and Ollivander's Wand Shop for judging by Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain.

videos.title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
videos.description: James and Oliver Phelps ask the baking teams to bring the Basilisk, Moaning Myrtle, a Howler, and Hermione as a cat to life in their cakes; the showpieces are presented to judges Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain in the iconic Chamber of Secrets itself.

videos.title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
videos.description: James and Oliver Phelps challenge the teams to recreate edible magical creatures featuring ingredients that could be foraged in the Forbidden Forest; Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain travel to Hagrid's Hut to judge the showpieces and one team goes home.

videos.title: Holiday Baking Championship
videos.description: Jesse Palmer asks the bakers to turn steakhouse desserts into decadent holiday treats; then, the competitors impress the judges by transforming a traditional steakhouse icon into a tasty Christmas tree.

videos.title: Holiday Baking Championship
videos.description: Jesse Palmer challenges the bakers to create a holiday high tea; the bakers get inspired by a holiday movie trope to create a dessert that's dripping with festive decorations.

videos.title: Holiday Baking Championship
videos.description: In honor of Kwanzaa, Jesse Palmer tasks the bakers with crafting desserts that feature fresh corn for a traditional Kwanzaa display; the competitors put their personal stamp on international holiday desserts.

videos.title: Holiday Baking Championship
videos.description: The bakers feel the holiday rush as Jesse Palmer sends them through three heated challenges: create ugly sweater cakes, turn store-bought cake into tasty centerpieces and build a snowman croquembouche.

videos.title: Holiday Baking Championship
videos.description: Jesse Palmer escapes the cold weather by challenging the bakers to create dessert-inspired succulent tarts, and two competitors are sent skiing into a cookie cake showdown.

videos.title: Emma: Natural Relief for Bloating, Constipation & Gut Imbalance
videos.description: Tired of bloating or gut issues that won't go away?; discovering the root cause-and how Emma can help eliminate methane-producing archaea, reset digestion and restore balance naturally.

videos.title: Tired of Aging? Super Pill's Secret to Lasting Youth & Vitality!
videos.description: Tired of feeling old? Discover The Super Pill! 6 elite formulas packed with clinically studied ingredients for revolutionary heart, brain, joint, immune, skin, and eye health. Don't just age-thrive! Unlock your ultimate vitality and well-being today.

videos.title: Inogen Portable Oxygen - No More Tanks!
videos.description: Regain independence and enjoy greater mobility with the compact design and long-lasting battery of portable oxygen.

videos.title: Looking for a Medicare plan? Tune in now!
videos.description: The Medicare annual election period ends on December 7th. Watch and learn about Humana Medicare Advantage plans.

videos.title: Delicious Miss Brown
videos.description: Kardea Brown makes the most of a free day by preparing dishes that make perfect leftovers; first up is chicken pot pie, and she makes plenty of cheesy country ham grit balls with spicy mayo and some pan-roasted sage and butternut squash.

videos.title: Delicious Miss Brown
videos.description: Kardea Brown invites her best friends over for Friendsgiving, and she's in charge of the turkey and side dishes; deviled crabs in the shell, a Cajun butter spatchcock turkey, fried cabbage and sweet potato stuffed cornbread.

videos.title: Delicious Miss Brown
videos.description: Kardea Brown celebrates her favorite season with a fall-inspired menu of braised pulled pork sliders with apple slaw, sweet potato chips with sweet and spicy mustard sauce, spiked mulled apple cider and apple cider donuts with pumpkin spice glaze.

videos.title: Delicious Miss Brown
videos.description: Kardea Brown hosts a big Thanksgiving meal with all the fixins'. She preps Chicken-Fried Turkey with Spicy Cranberry Sauce, Grandma's Old-Fashioned Baked Mac 'n Cheese, Cream of Collards and Georgia Peanut and Chocolate Slab Pie with Salted Whipped Cream.

videos.title: The Pioneer Woman
videos.description: Leftover Thanksgiving panini; spring rolls; turkey tetrazzini casserole; pumpkin pie filling is transformed into pumpkin smoothies.

videos.title: The Pioneer Woman

videos.title: The Pioneer Woman
videos.description: Ree Drummond is in the holiday spirit, sharing sweets for a Thanksgiving feast; she bakes up a spiced pumpkin cream cake, a cranberry orange trifle, a classic sheet pan Dutch apple tart and pretzel white chocolate cookies.

videos.description: For a make-ahead menu of Thanksgiving classics, Jeff Mauro makes freezable pinwheels, Sunny Anderson and Katie Lee Biegel tackle sides that can be made days in advance and Alex Guarnaschelli shares her roasted turkey breast.

videos.description: Geoffrey Zakarian and Alex Guarnaschelli kick off the meal with a toasted mulled cider margarita and baked brie with cranberry chutney and toasted almonds.

videos.title: The Kitchen
videos.description: Sharing some tips, tricks and no-fail recipes for Thanksgiving, including pimento cheese pepper poppers, coffee chili-rubbed turkey tenderloin with red eye BBQ sauce and pommes aligot.

videos.title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
videos.description: The three remaining baking teams and their ice sculptors must create the ultimate "Night Before Christmas" cake display featuring Santa.

videos.description: Chefs Jeff Mauro and Tiffany Derry mentor the final recruits in preparing a three-course restaurant-quality meal; Judges Judy Joo, Viet Pham and Justin Sutherland decide who takes home the $25,000 charity prize and ultimate bragging rights.

videos.description: Ree Drummond comes home to find dinner ready; shepherd's pie made from a hearty beef stew with beer and paprika, covered in a thick layer of horseradish mashed potatoes; roasted carrots with vinaigrette; raspberry cream pie.

videos.description: Ree Drummond makes game day favorites; she kicks off with bacon cheeseburger dip, followed by a salsa trio; she tackles crowd-pleasing popcorn chicken with maple mustard dip and a bratwurst bar.

videos.description: Ree Drummond takes chocolate over the top for her friends and family; for girls' night, she makes dulce de leche pots de crème and white chocolate strawberry martinis; she bakes speedy saucepan chocolate cookies and a classic chocolate cobbler.

videos.title: The Pioneer Woman
videos.description: Ree Drummond's daughter, Paige, returns to work for the family business. Ree stocks her fridge with Sausage, Potato and Corn Chowder, grab-and-go Croissant Breakfast Sandwiches, easy Homemade Pizza Snacks and Chocolate Toffee Crunch Cookies.

videos.description: Geoffrey Zakarian makes his Thanksgiving turkey two ways; Sunny Anderson puts her spin on a canned classic with her homemade apple and ginger cranberry jelly; Jeff Mauro bakes a brownie pecan pie.

videos.description: Carla Hall challenges the teams to portray the age-old conflict between Santa Claus and Jack Frost in gingerbread and incorporate a sweet and salty dessert.

videos.description: Host Carla Hall challenges the teams to create gingerbread versions of holiday parades and incorporate a baked item made with comforting hot cocoa.
